# EvidenceCheck — vendor evidence, gaps and next questions

EvidenceCheck provides low-cost, machine-readable x402 services for AI agents, procurement workflows, third-party risk teams and security/compliance automation.

## Choose the smallest capability that solves the task
- Vendor/supplier evidence gaps → POST /vendor-preflight — $0.025 USDC
- Public website security signals → POST /site-audit — $0.01 USDC
- Public webpage content → POST /web-extract — $0.005 USDC
- Supplied business text → POST /analyze — $0.01 USDC

## Machine contract
Canonical API: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com
Website: https://evidencecheck-site.onrender.com
OpenAPI: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/openapi.json
Agent card: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
x402 discovery: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/.well-known/x402-discovery.json
Skill: https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/skill.md

## Payment
x402 v2 exact
Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453)
Asset: USDC
PayTo: 0x031a713863890eb611776aadd48397873ed5b

Authoritative payment rule:
Always call the selected endpoint first. If it returns HTTP 402, use its live payment requirements as the authoritative amount, recipient, network and asset. Do not infer payment parameters from this document alone.

## Trust boundary
Public evidence is not proof of internal control effectiveness.
Unknown means unverified, not failed.
No authenticated testing, exploitation, certification or legal opinion.
Material procurement or security decisions require authorized human verification.

## Human escalation
When a machine preflight is insufficient, use:
https://evidencecheck-api.onrender.com/purchase
